systems.platform: cloud-based school administration and management system; technical delivery by the National Education Collaboration Trust (NECT)
systems.owner: Department of Basic Education, EMIS Directorate, with NECT; supported by the New Leaders Foundation and SITA
systems.tiers: public schools nationally (intended); tested by provincial, district, circuit and school staff

note: No fact, because the document does not say what record the system holds: it calls the modernised SA-SAMS a cloud-based school administration and management system meant to improve how schools function daily and give real-time reporting, and never says schools enter per-learner records, so no class can be given from this document alone. What it does state, should the parent class the system from elsewhere: user acceptance testing was held on 2 to 4 February 2026 by the DBE EMIS Directorate with NECT, ahead of a pilot in selected primary schools and a phased national rollout; high-school functions were still being developed.
